basic_details.job_title: BMC Sonologist (Public Health) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: BMC Recruitment 2026: Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation, through its Public Health Department, will select 3 Sonologists for a panel at Savitribai Phule Mother and Child Municipal Hospital (Riddhi Garden Municipal Maternity Home), Malad (East), in P/East Ward. Handwritten applications with supporting documents are accepted from 23 October 2026 to 4 November 2026, from 10.00 am to 18.00 (6.00 pm), not counting weekly holidays and public holidays. Applications must reach the Medical Officer's office at the hospital in Malad (East), Mumbai, by 4 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About BMC
content_sections.text: The notice comes from the Public Health Department of Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation, Mumbai's municipal corporation. The posts are at Savitribai Phule Mother and Child Municipal Hospital, also called Riddhi Garden Municipal Maternity Home, in Malad (East), P/East Ward. The panel is being formed under circular No. एचओ/19816/आस्था-2 dated 13 December 2025.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Write the application yourself, by hand (स्वहस्ताक्षरात), and address it to the Medical Officer, Savitribai Phule Mother and Child Municipal Hospital (Riddhi Garden Municipal Maternity Home), Malad (East). Send it with your supporting documents (सहकागदपत्रे) to this office address: Medical Officer, Savitribai Phule Mata v Bal Manapa Rugnalaya (Riddhi Garden Manapa Prasutigruh), New Valentine Apartment, Riddhi Garden Complex, Dindoshi, Malad (East), Mumbai-400097 Only sonologists who meet all the conditions below should apply. Your application must reach the office between 23 October 2026 and 4 November 2026, from 10.00 am to 18.00. The notice does not say how to send it (by hand or by post) and does not give an application form. It also does not say what to write on the envelope, and it does not list the supporting documents one by one. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post, Sonologist, with 3 places on the panel. The notice lists these qualifications for doctors appointed to the Sonologist panel: The candidate should hold a Post Graduate degree/ diploma/ DNB in the concerned subject. The candidate should have 1 year of experience after obtaining the Post Graduate degree. A certificate of registration with the Maharashtra Medical Council is required. For the additional qualification, a certificate of registration or renewal with the Maharashtra Medical Council is required. Age limit: The age limit for doctors on the Sonologist panel is up to 65 years. The notice gives no "as on" date for age. Panel doctors are paid for each scan, under the notice's "Sonologist Panel Honorarium Table" (proposed honorarium): For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, check the official notification.

rows.service: Sonologist service (Anomaly Scan / Colour Doppler / 2D Echo)

content_sections.heading: BMC Sonologist Job Description
content_sections.text: The Sonologist panel is being set up for surgeries of in-patients (आंतररुग्ण) at the hospital. Specialists on the panel are to be called for surgeries in rotation (चक्राकार पद्धतीने). Sonologists should be available for emergency surgeries as well as regular surgeries.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A total of 3 Sonologists will be selected for the panel. Sonologists will also be selected for a waiting list (प्रतिक्षायादी). The final decision on who joins the panel rests with the Executive Health Officer, Public Health Department.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applications are not accepted on weekly holidays or public holidays.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Each maternity home should have at least two specialists on its Sonologist panel. Panel specialists should preferably live near the maternity home or hospital.

faq.question: Q1. How many Sonologist posts are in BMC Recruitment 2026 at Malad (East)?
faq.answer: A total of 3 Sonologists will be selected for the panel at Savitribai Phule Mother and Child Municipal Hospital (Riddhi Garden Municipal Maternity Home), Malad (East). Sonologists will also be selected for a waiting list.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the BMC Sonologist application?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Medical Officer's office by 4 November 2026, 18.00. They are accepted from 23 October 2026, from 10.00 am to 18.00, but not on weekly holidays or public holidays.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the BMC Sonologist panel?
faq.answer: You need a Post Graduate degree/ diploma/ DNB in the concerned subject and 1 year of experience after the Post Graduate degree. You also need registration with the Maharashtra Medical Council, plus registration or renewal for the additional qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the BMC Sonologist panel?
faq.answer: The age limit for doctors on the Sonologist panel is up to 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. How much will BMC pay panel Sonologists?
faq.answer: The proposed honorarium is Rs 250/- per sonography for general sonology. For an Anomaly Scan, Colour Doppler or 2D Echo, it is Rs 500/- per scan.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the BMC Sonologist panel?
faq.answer: Write the application by hand, address it to the Medical Officer, and send it with your supporting documents. It must reach this address by 4 November 2026: Medical Officer, Savitribai Phule Mata v Bal Manapa Rugnalaya (Riddhi Garden Manapa Prasutigruh), New Valentine Apartment, Riddhi Garden Complex, Dindoshi, Malad (East), Mumbai-400097.

faq.question: Q7. Who makes the final selection for the BMC Sonologist panel?
faq.answer: The final decision on selecting Sonologists for the panel rests with the Executive Health Officer, Public Health Department.

faq.question: Q8. Will panel Sonologists have to attend emergency cases?
faq.answer: Yes. Sonologists should be available for emergency surgeries as well as regular surgeries, and panel specialists are called for surgeries in rotation.
